review.notes: Full review of an unchanged head. All 15 sampled targets read against their sources at the locators (41 locators in 15 texts: Stacks ch. 60, Bhatt-Lurie-Mathew, Kato, Grosse-Kloenne, Illusie, Shiho, Clausen-Mathew-Morrow, BMS1, BMS2, Temkin, Binda-Kato-Vezzani, Du-Moon-Shimizu, Beilinson, Esnault-Groechenig, Illusie's overview). Adversarial table with computed values for every sampled target and both Lean headlines. Automatic checks all pass; dependency check 0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; one-tactic probes (simp, rfl, infer_instance, decide) fail on both theorems. Pull request text matches the head. Corrections: three carried from the previous review (scope sentence, undefined symbols in CR.7.3 base change, pointer in cup products), two new (Kummer definition cited to Temkin, which lacks it; log smooth base change stated for the ordinary log fibre product). No finding, nothing for a human to decide.
